description: This Java class models a payment transaction within an e-commerce system. It is an entity mapped to the SM_TRANSACTION table, containing fields for transaction details such as amount, date, type, payment method, and related order. It also supports auditing and JSON serialization of transaction details.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Represents a payment transaction with details such as amount, date, type, payment method, and associated order.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section containing metadata for auditing.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for the transaction.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the transaction.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the transaction.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an order with this transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.

methods.name: setTransactionDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the transaction.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns detailed information about the transaction.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets detailed information about the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDetails
methods.description: Returns the map of transaction details.

methods.name: setTransactionDetails
methods.description: Sets the map of transaction details.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes transaction details to JSON format; logs error if serialization fails.
